content.value_statement: Broken JSON blocks API tests, configuration changes, and data reviews. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code validate, format, and repair JSON with clear explanations.
actual_capabilities: Validates JSON syntax and identifies common error types.
Explains problems such as trailing commas, comments, single quotes, and unquoted keys.
Formats minified JSON with two-space indentation.
Suggests corrections while preserving data types.
Analyzes top-level type, key names, nesting depth, and array sizes.
Guides conversion from JSON to YAML, TOML, CSV, or XML.
limitations: It does not execute a standalone parser unless the host agent uses one.
Very large documents may exceed model context limits.
Automatic fixes can change meaning when source data is ambiguous.
Format conversion may need human review for nested arrays or mixed types.

use_cases.title: Validate API Responses
use_cases.description: Check returned JSON for syntax problems, unreadable formatting, and structural patterns before debugging an integration.

use_cases.title: Repair Configuration Files
use_cases.description: Find strict JSON errors in configuration snippets and get safe, explained corrections before deployment.

use_cases.title: Understand Nested Payloads
use_cases.description: Summarize keys, nesting depth, repeated structures, and array sizes in complex data files.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Basic JSON
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this JSON text. Identify syntax errors, explain each issue, and suggest a corrected version only after explaining the fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation for a small snippet

prompt_templates.title: Format Compact Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Format this JSON with two-space indentation. Preserve value types and ask before sorting keys or removing comments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Readable formatting for compact API output

prompt_templates.title: Analyze API Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this API response for JSON validity and structure. Summarize nesting depth, repeated shapes, optional fields, and data quality issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an integration payload

prompt_templates.title: Convert With Review Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this JSON dataset to YAML, then describe any ambiguous values or structures that require manual review before use.

output_examples.input: A configuration file has a trailing comma and single quoted keys.
output: Reports the invalid comma and quote style with line context.
Provides a corrected version description and explains why strict JSON rejects both issues.

output_examples.input: An API response is minified and difficult to review.
output_examples.output: Returns a readable structure with two-space indentation, preserved types, and an optional note about key sorting.

output_examples.input: A user wants to understand a nested payload.
output_examples.output: Summarizes top-level type, key counts, nesting depth, arrays, and likely schema patterns.

best_practices: Validate syntax before formatting or converting.
Ask before sorting keys, removing comments, or changing structure.
Review corrected data against the source system before applying it.
anti_patterns: Paste secrets or production credentials into validation prompts.
Accept automatic repairs without checking changed fields.
Treat JSON5, comments, or trailing commas as strict JSON.

faq.question: Can this skill fix invalid JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies common errors and suggests corrected JSON while explaining each change.

faq.question: Does it run code?
faq.answer: No. The skill is instructional and relies on the host agent unless tools are separately invoked.

faq.question: Can it format minified JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. It can format compact data with two-space indentation and preserve data types.

faq.question: Can it convert JSON to YAML?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives conversion guidance and highlights structures that may need review.

faq.question: Is it safe for secrets?
faq.answer: No. Do not paste tokens, credentials, or private production data into prompts.

faq.question: Does it validate schemas?
faq.answer: It can inspect structure and suggest schema-like summaries, but it is not a complete schema validator.
